issues_breakdown.title: SQLite Thread Contention and Database Locks during High-Frequency Tick Bursts
issues_breakdown.description: Synchronous database writes during high tick volume caused sqlite3.OperationalError locks.
issues_breakdown.root_cause: Default journal mode and tight connection timeout without retry backoff.
issues_breakdown.remediation: Implemented DatabaseInfrastructure with WAL mode (PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;), 60.0s connection timeouts, 60,000ms busy timeouts, and _execute_with_retry exponential backoff wrappers.

issues_breakdown.title: Static Fixed Lot Sizing Failing Equity Scaling Requirements
issues_breakdown.description: Previous fixed 0.01 lot size constraint prevented compounding and optimal equity allocation.
issues_breakdown.root_cause: Hardcoded lot sizing logic in position generation.
issues_breakdown.remediation: Upgraded _calculate_lot_size in brain.py to dynamic Fractional Kelly and ATR Volatility Sizing, retaining 0.01 lot as an absolute safety baseline floor.

issues_breakdown.title: Wide Spread Slippage during High-Impact News Releases
issues_breakdown.description: Market orders executed during spread expansion events caused excessive initial drawdowns.
issues_breakdown.root_cause: Absence of dynamic spread volatility circuit breaker.
issues_breakdown.remediation: Added Spread Volatility Spike Breaker in main.py rejecting setups when current spread > 2.5 * 20-period average spread.

issues_breakdown.title: Correlated Cross-Asset Drawdown Cascades
issues_breakdown.description: Simultaneous positions in correlated currency pairs amplified floating losses.
issues_breakdown.root_cause: Isolated signal evaluation per symbol without basket correlation checks.
issues_breakdown.remediation: Enforced symbol loss protection gate (blocking new entries on symbols with floating loss) and portfolio-wide basket correlation checks.

issues_breakdown.title: O(N^2) Array Scanning for Unmitigated Fair Value Gaps (FVG)
issues_breakdown.description: Scanning full bar history for FVGs on every tick created unnecessary CPU overhead.
issues_breakdown.remediation: Implemented FVGCacheEngine ring-buffer active imbalance updates in smc_ict_engine.py reducing updates to O(1).

issues_breakdown.title: Cold-Start Neural Model Prediction Latency / Failure on Fresh Symbol
issues_breakdown.description: Neural model initialization delays on newly registered symbols stalled prediction pipelines.
issues_breakdown.root_cause: Lack of statistical fallback predictors during model warm-up.
issues_breakdown.remediation: Added EWMA and Holt-Winters statistical forecasting fallback in predictive_brain.py.

issues_breakdown.title: GUI Main Thread Canvas Lag during DOM High-Frequency Redrawing
issues_breakdown.description: Unthrottled DOM canvas updates during tick bursts caused Tkinter UI freezes.
issues_breakdown.root_cause: Redrawing canvas on every tick event without rate limiting.
issues_breakdown.remediation: Implemented 100ms canvas redraw debouncing (_last_dom_redraw_time) in gui.py.

issues_breakdown.title: Silent Exception Suppression Swallow Failure Context
issues_breakdown.description: Unlogged bare except clauses obscured non-critical diagnostic errors.
issues_breakdown.remediation: Replaced all silent except blocks across core modules with explicit diagnostic exception logging.

gap_analysis.protocol_support: Closed via UniversalBrokerGateway supporting MT5 Native, FIX 4.4 Protocol, REST/WS, IBKR, cTrader, CCXT, and Simulator.
gap_analysis.concurrency: Closed via brain_agents_orchestrator.py ProcessPoolExecutor for multi-agent strategy evaluation and predictive_brain.py ThreadPoolExecutor.
gap_analysis.risk_invariants: Closed via 12 System Execution Planes and 15 System Safety Invariants in eqats_planes.py.
gap_analysis.headless_vps: Closed via --headless CLI flag in main.py and config.py for 24x7 VPS daemon execution.

risks_and_mitigations.hardware_failure: Auto-recovery via watchdog daemon and state persistence in scalper_state.txt and SQLite WAL database.
risks_and_mitigations.network_disruption: Heartbeat monitors and automatic order cancellation / SL enforcement on broker side.
risks_and_mitigations.extreme_volatility: Spread Spike Breakers, Maximum Drawdown Circuit Breakers, and Hard Kill Switches.
